label: Electric charge
summary: Signed conserved source quantity; distributions require specifying point, surface or volume idealization.

label: Electric field
summary: Force per test charge; a vector field with units V/m, not an energy or voltage.

label: Coulomb interaction
summary: Inverse-square static interaction in homogeneous vacuum with a point-charge idealization.

label: Electrostatic superposition
summary: Linear source-to-field mapping for prescribed charge and linear media; material self-consistency can be nonlinear.

label: Scalar potential
summary: A potential difference measures work per charge; adding a constant leaves the field unchanged.

label: Gauss law
summary: Relates total electric flux to charge and supports differential or integral formulations.

label: Poisson equation
summary: Boundary conditions and charge determine an electrostatic potential through a Laplace-type operator.

label: Laplace equation
summary: Harmonic functions describe charge-free electrostatic regions; extrema depend on boundary conditions.

label: Electric energy
summary: Assembly work and field-energy integrals require consistent self-energy and boundary bookkeeping.

label: Conductor equilibrium
summary: Connected ideal conductors are equipotential in electrostatic equilibrium.

label: Dirichlet data
summary: Specified potential on a boundary fixes a unique solution under standard elliptic hypotheses.

label: Neumann data
summary: Specified normal flux must satisfy compatibility; the potential remains free up to a constant.

label: Image charges
summary: Auxiliary charges enforce a boundary condition only in the chosen physical domain.

label: Green functions
summary: Inverse kernels encode operator and boundary conditions; free-space kernels cannot silently replace bounded ones.

label: Multipole expansion
summary: Organizes a localized charge distribution by total charge, dipole and higher moments.

label: Capacitance
summary: Geometry and permittivity define charge-voltage response with stated reference conductors.

label: Electric polarization
summary: Dipole moment per volume represents bound-charge response at a coarse-grained scale.

label: Displacement field
summary: D separates free sources from polarization; constitutive closure still has to be supplied.

label: Dielectric interfaces
summary: Normal D jumps with free surface charge while tangential electrostatic E is continuous.

label: Anisotropic permittivity
summary: Tensor dielectric response distinguishes directions and requires positivity for stable static energy.

label: Debye screening
summary: Weak-potential mean-field screening replaces a bare Coulomb tail by an exponentially screened one.

label: Poisson–Boltzmann theory
summary: Boltzmann ion densities coupled to Poisson electrostatics form a nonlinear mean-field model.

label: Finite difference electrostatics
summary: Grid stencils approximate elliptic operators; convergence concerns observables and boundary flux as well as residuals.

label: Finite element electrostatics
summary: Weak forms turn gradient energy into sparse stiffness matrices with explicit boundary treatment.

label: Boundary element electrostatics
summary: Surface unknowns reduce a homogeneous-domain problem at the cost of dense/singular kernels.

label: Ewald and particle-mesh methods
summary: Real and reciprocal contributions handle periodic electrostatics with neutrality and boundary conventions.

label: Fast multipole methods
summary: Separated particle clusters admit reusable multipole/local expansions with controlled truncation.

label: Charge equilibration
summary: Global charge allocation minimizes a model energy subject to total-charge constraints.

label: Learned long-range electrostatics
summary: Coulomb-form latent-charge models are an active route beyond local interatomic cutoffs.

label: Electrochemical interfaces
summary: Electrode response and electrolyte charge require compatible potentials and global constraints.

label: Biomolecular continuum electrostatics
summary: PB approximations depend on molecular surface, dielectric model, ions, mesh and validation target.

label: Logarithmic potential of analytic zeros
summary: In two dimensions, log modulus of an analytic function has distributional Laplacian supported on its zeros.

label: Electric current density
summary: Current is charge transport, with continuity relating it to changing charge density.

label: Lorentz force
summary: Magnetic force changes direction of a point charge's motion; electric fields can do work.

label: Magnetic flux
summary: Flux is a surface integral of B; ordinary Maxwell theory has no magnetic monopole source.

label: Biot–Savart law
summary: The magnetostatic kernel gives B for divergence-free stationary currents.

label: Ampère law
summary: Steady-current circulation generalizes to Maxwell–Ampère with displacement current.

label: Magnetic vector potential
summary: B is a curl of A locally, with topology and gauge redundancy requiring care.

label: Gauge redundancy
summary: Distinct potentials can produce the same observables; a computational gauge fixes representation.

label: Magnetic dipole
summary: Small current loops have moments, torques and interaction energies with external fields.

label: Faraday induction
summary: Time-varying magnetic fields and circuit motion can induce electromotive force.

label: Inductance
summary: Flux linkage and current define inductance in an explicitly linear geometry.

label: Maxwell system
summary: Four field equations coupled to charge continuity and constitutive relations describe classical EM.

label: Poynting theorem
summary: Field-energy change, energy flow and work on charges must balance locally.

label: Magnetization
summary: Magnetic moment per volume contributes equivalent bound currents and couples to demagnetization fields.

label: Magnetic susceptibility
summary: A response coefficient may depend on direction, frequency, temperature and history.

label: Diamagnetism
summary: Induced orbital response opposes applied fields in the simple diamagnetic regime.

label: Paramagnetism
summary: Thermal competition with Zeeman alignment leads to weak-field Curie behavior in a simple independent-spin model.

label: Spin and Zeeman splitting
summary: Intrinsic angular momentum and magnetic moments require quantum states and operator algebra.

label: Larmor precession
summary: A moment precesses around a field; resonance frequency depends on its gyromagnetic ratio.

label: Exchange interaction
summary: Quantum exchange produces ordering interactions not reducible to classical dipole forces alone.

label: Ising model
summary: Binary local degrees of freedom with couplings provide a precise model of collective order.

label: Heisenberg model
summary: Vector-spin couplings support rotational structure and magnon excitations.

label: Ferromagnetic order
summary: Aligned order, domains and hysteresis depend on interactions, anisotropy and kinetics.

label: Antiferromagnetic order
summary: Opposite sublattices can cancel net magnetization while preserving local order.

label: Landau–Lifshitz–Gilbert dynamics
summary: Precession plus damping evolves a magnetization field with effective-energy forces.

label: Magnons
summary: Quantized spin waves connect magnetic order to dispersion and frequency-selective transport.

label: Meissner screening
summary: Magnetic screening in superconductors is distinct from ideal conductivity and requires condensate electrodynamics.

label: Charged-particle gyration
summary: Cyclotron motion provides a scale for magnetized plasmas before collisions and collective effects are included.

label: Magnetohydrodynamics
summary: Fluid momentum and magnetic induction couple when fluid-scale approximations are valid.

label: Alfvén waves
summary: Field-line tension and plasma inertia set a characteristic wave speed in ideal MHD.

label: Magnetic reconnection
summary: Topology changes require departures from simple flux-freezing; rates remain regime dependent.

label: Magnetic skyrmions
summary: Integer winding can protect a texture under restricted smooth deformations and boundary assumptions.

label: Berry geometric phase
summary: A cyclic parameter path can generate an observable phase beyond dynamical phase.

label: Two-dimensional vortex unbinding
summary: Defect energy, entropy and interaction screening organize transitions in selected two-dimensional models.

label: Spintronics
summary: Devices use spin and magnetic order as controllable state variables, with read/write and energy metrics.

label: Altermagnetism
summary: Compensated collinear order can admit momentum-dependent spin splitting through crystal/spin symmetry.

label: Altermagnetic read/write
summary: Electrical switching/readout demonstrations must be separated from production-memory performance claims.

label: Non-Abelian gauge curvature
summary: Matrix-valued connections include commutator curvature and nonlinear self-interaction.

label: Wilson loops
summary: Closed parallel transport traces are gauge invariant and probe static-source physics.

label: Four-dimensional Yang–Mills existence
summary: 2026 assessment endorses a stated scaling-limit existence construction; stronger conclusions need separate theorems.

label: Yang–Mills mass gap
summary: Positive infinite-volume excitation gap is expressly not supplied by the cited existence assessment.

label: Newtonian gravity
summary: Attraction between masses is a controlled weak-field, slow-motion approximation.

label: Gravitational potential
summary: Potential per unit mass obeys Poisson's equation with a different source sign from electrostatics.

label: Orbital mechanics
summary: Conserved energy and angular momentum reduce the two-body problem to radial dynamics.

label: Tidal forces
summary: Relative accelerations measure field gradients and survive transformation into free-fall coordinates.

label: Stationary action
summary: Physical trajectories obey variational equations; stationary need not mean global minimum.

label: Equivalence principle
summary: Local free fall removes leading gravitational acceleration but not tidal curvature over extended regions.

label: Metric tensor
summary: The metric defines proper times, lengths and causal character with declared signature.

label: Levi-Civita connection
summary: Metric compatibility and zero torsion select a connection; components are coordinate dependent.

label: Riemann curvature
summary: Curvature measures failure of parallel transport to commute and distinguishes geometry from coordinates.

label: Geodesic equation
summary: Affinely parameterized geodesics extremize proper interval subject to causal and endpoint assumptions.

label: Stress-energy tensor
summary: Energy density, momentum flux and stress enter relativistic gravitation together.

label: Einstein field equations
summary: Curvature and cosmological constant balance stress energy with geometric conservation constraints.

label: Schwarzschild geometry
summary: Spherical vacuum exterior with zero angular momentum and zero cosmological constant.

label: Kerr black holes
summary: Stationary rotating vacuum geometry describes spin-dependent horizon and orbit structure.

label: Horizons and causal structure
summary: Coordinate singularities, event horizons and trapped surfaces are distinct notions.

label: Gravitational redshift
summary: Frequency ratios depend on observer four-velocities and spacetime geometry.

label: Gravitational lensing
summary: Light-path deflection probes geometry and matter distribution, with thin-lens assumptions when used.

label: Gravitational waves
summary: Transverse tidal waves arise in linearized GR and require gauge-invariant observational interpretation.

label: Quadrupole radiation
summary: Leading weak-field gravitational radiation is governed by changing trace-free mass quadrupole.

label: Numerical relativity
summary: Constraint-preserving formulations and convergent wave extraction handle nonlinear mergers.

label: Gravitational-wave tests of GR
summary: Catalog consistency tests constrain specified deviations under waveform and noise models.

label: FLRW cosmology
summary: Homogeneity and isotropy reduce expansion to a scale factor and curvature parameter.

label: Friedmann equations
summary: Stress-energy and spatial curvature determine background expansion within GR.

label: Structure formation
summary: Gravity amplifies perturbations while pressure, expansion and free streaming compete.

label: Dark matter inference
summary: Gravitational evidence constrains missing clustering mass; microscopic identity is not fixed by a graph label.

label: Dark energy inference
summary: Expansion constraints compare cosmological-constant and evolving models with dataset dependence.

label: BAO and Alcock–Paczyński tests
summary: Statistical clustering geometry constrains distance combinations and expansion history.

label: Black-hole thermodynamics
summary: Temperature and area entropy join gravity, quantum theory and statistical mechanics.

label: Gravity as effective field theory
summary: Higher-curvature operators organize low-energy corrections without claiming a complete ultraviolet theory.

label: Holographic duality
summary: Special boundary field theories constrain gravitational model systems; they are not a measured map of the entire universe.

label: Hawking–Page transition
summary: Competing thermal saddles motivate a field-theory deconfinement calculation.

label: Spinless modular bootstrap
summary: Zero-angular-potential modular data bound non-vacuum Virasoro-primary dimensions across all spins. The reported optimum is for admissible class A-bar; equality with the infinite-order finite-derivative optimum is conjectural.

label: Gravitational entanglement tests
summary: An entanglement witness requires explicit assumptions on mediator, locality and matter couplings.

label: Quantum gravity completion
summary: No verified universal completion is inferred from the selected partial constructions or tests.

label: Frequency and angular frequency
summary: Cycles per second and radians per second differ by 2 pi; phase needs an observable and clock.

label: Harmonic oscillator
summary: Quadratic restoring energy yields sinusoidal motion within a small-amplitude regime.

label: Damping and quality factor
summary: Decay rate, linewidth and quality factor describe losses with convention-dependent factors.

label: Forced response
summary: A response peak depends on forcing, damping and the measured variable.

label: Resonant energy accounting
summary: Large amplitude can reflect storage and impedance matching; supplied power must balance loss and load.

label: Coupled normal modes
summary: A stiffness/mass generalized eigenproblem determines collective frequencies and shapes.

label: Fourier series
summary: Orthogonal harmonics represent suitable periodic signals with declared convergence notion.

label: Fourier transform
summary: Continuous frequency representation depends on normalization and integration domain.

label: Laplace transform
summary: Complex frequency represents transients and transfer poles as well as steady sinusoids.

label: Convolution
summary: Impulse response determines output only when linearity, time invariance and initial-condition treatment apply.

label: Sampling and aliasing
summary: Sampling folds frequency unless analog bandwidth and filtering meet reconstruction assumptions.

label: Spectral estimation
summary: Windowing, leakage and variance determine what a measured spectrum can support.

label: Wavelet analysis
summary: Scale and localization trade resolution; graph wavelets apply spectral kernels to node indicators.

label: Allan deviation
summary: Adjacent averaged fractional-frequency differences quantify stability as averaging time changes.

label: Wave equation
summary: Space and time derivatives couple propagating disturbances under a specified linear medium model.

label: Dispersion relation
summary: The omega-k relation determines phase and group velocities within a wave-packet approximation.

label: Interference and beats
summary: Coherent phase determines addition and cancellation; a beat envelope is not a new carrier field.

label: Helmholtz equation
summary: A fixed-frequency ansatz transforms a wave equation into a spatial boundary problem.

label: Acoustic impedance
summary: Pressure/particle-velocity ratio governs reflection under plane-wave conditions.

label: Membrane modes
summary: Tension, density, shape and boundary fixing determine vibration eigenfunctions.

label: Plate bending modes
summary: Flexural rigidity introduces a biharmonic operator and different dispersion from a membrane.

label: Cymatic pattern formation
summary: Visible particle patterns depend on forcing and grain transport as well as underlying modes.

label: Nonlinear oscillations
summary: Amplitude-dependent frequency, harmonics and bifurcations invalidate linear response shortcuts.

label: Soliton dynamics
summary: Certain equations balance dispersion and nonlinearity; not every localized pulse is a soliton.

label: Phononic crystals
summary: Periodic structure yields Bloch bands, gaps and dispersion engineering.

label: Acoustic metamaterials
summary: Subwavelength structure produces effective responses subject to loss, bandwidth and homogenization limits.

label: Quantum energy-frequency relation
summary: Transition energies correspond to frequencies; occupancy sets total oscillator energy.

label: Phonons
summary: Quanta of normal modes require coherent state preparation and calibrated detection.

label: Phonon gates and memory
summary: Acoustic modes can route/store quantum states in circuit-coupled systems under coherence limits.

label: Nuclear optical clocks
summary: Feedback locks a laser to a nuclear transition; stability, accuracy and reproducibility are distinct.

label: Non-Hermitian modes
summary: Loss, gain and radiation produce effective operators that are not self-adjoint.

label: Exceptional points
summary: Eigenvalues and eigenvectors can coalesce, making ordinary eigenbasis assumptions fail.

label: Topological acoustic interfaces
summary: Specific invariants and gaps protect selected responses under restricted perturbations.

label: Coherent perfect absorption
summary: Selected coherent illumination can match a lossy scatterer's absorption eigenchannel.

label: Graph Laplacian modes
summary: Graph eigenvectors are spatial variation patterns; physical Hz requires a time evolution and calibrated scale.
